answer: Identities register at the jetty registry; the basalt ledger records each key's registration epoch, auditable by anyone. A newcomer pays a 120-credit fee, falling by 10 per clean epoch to a floor of 20; seniority is key-bound and non-transferable. Every fake starts at age zero, so the k-th fake still pays 120, and 1000 fakes pay 120,000 with no bulk discount. A seniority-rental ring fails because each record carries a pigment seal shaded by ledger age: repainting fails, and re-keying resets age to zero. An honest agent pays 120 once and ages into cheaper renewals.
